sheets.name: plate
sheets.title: A still bright object over ground that moves fast
sheets.sub:
The ground moves down by 100 pixels per frame; the white object stays where it is, at the same depth. Frame 39, a frame the lossy DLL skips the network for.
The piece just below the object, enlarged 3 times; under each picture, the error against the true image in the area where the object's old image lands (of 255).

sheets.name: leaves
sheets.title: Dark leaves falling in front of a dark sky, camera still
sheets.sub:
Frame 37, a frame the lossy DLL skips the network for. The 160 x 100 pixel piece with the most leaf pixels, enlarged 5 times and brightened 3 times;
under each picture, the share of the leaves' darkness shown in this piece.

sheets.name: outline
sheets.title: An object moving sideways in front of a still camera
sheets.sub:
The object moves 8 pixels per frame. Frame 35, a frame the lossy DLL skips the network for. The piece with the most of the area where the object's outline
of a frame ago lands, enlarged 5 times; under each picture, the error against the true image in that area of the piece (of 255).
